name: Nantucket Nature Bound Program (Teen Naturalist Leadership Program)
description_short: A set of week-long afternoon nature programs (1:15-4:15pm) for teens aged 13-17, run by the Maria Mitchell Association on Nantucket. Each week has its own theme, such as coastal ecology, marine and land ecology, cross-island hikes, or behind-the-scenes work at the museum and aquarium.
refund_policy_summary: MMA may cancel a camper's spot without a refund if the medical and registration forms are not received at least two weeks before the session starts. The page gives no general refund policy.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers must show strong swimming ability to snorkel (this applies to the Marine and Terrestrial Ecology and Aquarists of Tomorrow programs). Activities also include kayaking and seining.
